title: The Shahadah
intro: With the Shahadah we say that we belong to Islam.

learn.html: We say that we belong to Islam by saying the Kalimat ash-Shahadah – the words of witness.

learn.label: The Shahadah
learn.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
learn.tr: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasooluhu
learn.en: I believe and declare that only Allah is God, and I believe and declare that Muhammad is Allah’s servant and Messenger.

items: an laa ilaaha illallaah – that there is no god except Allah
wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan – and I believe and declare that Muhammad
‘abduhu wa rasooluhu – is His servant and His Messenger

learn.html:
The Shahadah is the witness of Islam:
there is no god but Allah,
to Him be praise for ever,
and Muhammad, the beloved,
is Allah’s Messenger.
(R. Kadić)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The first part of the Shahadah says that only Allah is God. The second part says that Muhammad (SAW) is Allah’s servant and Messenger.
